courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水壩地震動力分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「幾何比例與控制長度」與「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水壩地震動力分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Geometry ratio and reference length" and "Reynolds number and viscous distortion" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic dynamic analysis of dams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用相似律與量測證據分辨水工縮尺模型可代表哪些現象；水壩地震動力分析則以從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on use similitude and measurement evidence to define what hydraulic scale models represent; Seismic dynamic analysis of dams centres on identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「幾何比例與控制長度」與「模態質量與週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水壩地震動力分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「附加水質量與週期」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Geometry ratio and reference length” and “Modal mass and period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic dynamic analysis of dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Added water mass and period", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「幾何比例與控制長度」與「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海堤越波模型試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Geometry ratio and reference length" and "Reynolds number and viscous distortion" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Overtopping model tests for seawalls must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用相似律與量測證據分辨水工縮尺模型可代表哪些現象；海堤越波模型試驗則以以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on use similitude and measurement evidence to define what hydraulic scale models represent; Overtopping model tests for seawalls centres on interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「幾何比例與控制長度」與「弗勞德縮尺條件」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海堤越波模型試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「取樣頻帶配置」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Geometry ratio and reference length” and “Froude scaling conditions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Overtopping model tests for seawalls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sampling bandwidth selection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水力模型縮尺試驗
history.text: 水工模型的價值來自可控制邊界並檢查機制，而不是宣稱微縮模型包含全部原型物理。墾務局一九八〇年水工實驗室技術手冊整理相似律、製作與量測方法，後續量水手冊解釋佛祿數在自由水面模型的角色。官方研究目錄列二〇一五年克利埃勒姆魚道模型及二〇一八年福爾松附加溢洪道閘門研究，顯示不同問題需要不同觀察量。Deltares另以伊默伊登分層流模型比較物理與數值結果。本課所有尺寸與流量獨立假設，不將案例曾用模型解釋成任意縮尺都可信。
history.textEn: Physical models offer controlled boundaries and mechanism checks rather than containing every prototype process in miniature. Reclamation’s1980 laboratory manual organizes similitude, fabrication and measurement, and its water-measurement guidance explains Froude similarity for free surfaces. The official catalogue lists2015 Cle Elum fish-passage studies and2018 Folsom auxiliary-spillway gate work, illustrating different questions and observations. Deltares separately compares physical and numerical stratified-flow models at IJmuiden. All dimensions and flows here are independently assumed; the existence of a landmark model study does not imply that any chosen reduction scale is reliable.
